comparison.objective: Use two orthogonal plotter knobs to trace two oblique line segments.
comparison.physical_skill: Coordinated rotary control of an XY mechanism and continuous path following rather than contact-loaded impact and fragment manipulation.
comparison.success_condition: Persistent trace must meet coverage and deviation criteria and finish released and stable; exact thresholds are not in the record.
comparison.reason: Shared bimanual coordination is generic; the tested ability and outcome—continuous trajectory production—differ materially from tang fracture and recovery.
